verdict.rationale: Chime SDK docs say bandwidth-constrained clients automatically subscribe to a lower-bitrate stream, which implies multi-bitrate (simulcast-style) publishing with per-subscriber adaptation. The evidence is a single sentence and never explicitly describes simulcast or layered encoding by publishers. missing for 10: explicit documentation of simulcast/SVC layer publishing, details of how layers are selected or switched per subscriber, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, publishers send layered or simulcast video and the service adapts the layer each subscriber receives to their bandwidth

citations.quote: Clients with bandwidth constraints automatically subscribe to the lower bitrate stream.
Each attendee can publish one video source, up to a total of 25 simultaneous videos per meeting.
